args.title: Handle trailing blank lines and carriage returns in parser
args.body:
File: src/ingest/parser.ts

Trim trailing whitespace and carriage returns from lines or filter out empty/whitespace-only trailing lines when parsing ingested files, preventing trailing blank lines from being treated as malformed data rows.

label: bug
file: src/ingest/parser.ts
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

Files ending with a blank line or carriage returns leave an empty or whitespace-only line in the lines array after popping the final newline, causing a malformed row error.
